text: Vehicles standing or stopping on the north side of Prince Arthur Avenue obstruct sightlines for drivers exiting and entering the garage at 50 Prince Arthur Avenue, posing a serious safety hazard. This letter would prohibit vehicles from standing near the exit of the garage, improving safety for drivers and pedestrians, and is supported by the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing at all times on the north side of Prince Arthur Avenue, between Bedford Road and a point 100 metres east of St. George Street.
